3.label: Coat D'Arms old Citadel match
3.text: Coat D'Arms match the OLD citadel colours (pre-1992) so there might be some difference. Shining gold has the most noticeable difference.

4.label: P3 old GW range caveat
4.text: Most P3 Paints do not match closely with the old GW range, but a detailed explanation of each paint can be found at the linked Brushthralls article.

5.label: GW claimed old/new match
5.text: GW's new range matches with the old range are the matches claimed by GW. However, many of the paints do not match very closely at all and some mixing will be required to get close to the original colours. If you are trying to match old GW with new GW, you'd be better just getting Vallejo game color or coat d'arms for the closest match.

7.label: 3rd-5th Edition replica
7.text: 3rd-5th Edition Replicas, same 98-99% matching criteria, masstone only.

struckThroughPaintName.label: tested non-match
struckThroughPaintName.text: A struck-through paint name indicates that after testing it does not match the GW color and is really far off.
